lab.title: Lesson 4.2: Enterprise Security Architecture
lab.blurb: Doom got onto the public dock network. Build zones of trust so they can't walk straight into the command deck.

story.alert: 06:20 · UNKNOWN DEVICE ON THE PUBLIC DOCK · CITADEL NETWORK
story.vex: Every network is one flat room if nobody bothers to build walls inside it. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The dock is still public, but the command deck is now its own locked room. Astro: "Zones of trust, Cadet. Not every device on our network deserves the same trust."

steps.title: Astro Says: build the wall between zones
steps.body: Astro: "Doom's device sits on the public dock network now. It must not be able to walk straight onto the command deck." On `citadel-fw`, set the default policy to block: `netsh advfirewall set allprofiles firewallpolicy blockinbound,allowoutbound`.

objectives.label: citadel-fw blocks routed traffic between zones by default

steps.title: Rivet's Workbench: open only what the crew needs
steps.body: Rivet: "The dock still needs the web service. Nothing else." On `citadel-fw`, allow only the web port through: `netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name=AllowWeb dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=80`.

objectives.label: dock-gate can still reach web-server on port 80
dock-gate is blocked from command-deck's port 445
